title: Loop color certificates
notes: Keep one adult at each table to manage the checked cords and read the tracing rule. K-1 first encounter can be P1 alone: identify an overstrand and trace one complete arc without switching strands. Let the child repeat this on the physical example and the unworked target; this is a real introductory challenge. Once whole-arc tracing is reliable, choose the plain-loop question (P3) or isolated missing-color cases (P5). The full trefoil catalog (P2) and two-crossing continuation (P6) are further readiness-dependent investigations, available on another visit. Grades 2-3 can return to local completion (P5-6); grades 4-5 can connect those checks to the supplied invariant and its one-way limit (P5-7). Actual cord/marker fit and model pretests remain unperformed.
